{{Recipe}}

'''Banga rice''' is a rice dish popular in the Delta State of Nigeria. It features [[Cookbook:Oil Palm Fruit|oil palm fruit]] concentrate, and it is both easy and delicious to make.

==Ingredients==
* 1½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Oil Palm Fruit#Uses|palm nut extract]]
* Fresh [[Cookbook:Habanero|habanero]] pepper
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Ground Crayfish|ground crayfish]]
* 2 tablespoon banga spice
* 3 [[Cookbook:Bouillon Cube|stock cubes]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
* 2½ cups uncooked [[Cookbook:Rice|rice]], rinsed and drained
* 2 medium [[Cookbook:Dryfish|smoked]] [[Cookbook:Catfish|catfish]] or [[Cookbook:Mackerel|titus fish]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Scent Leaf|scent leaf]], [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]

==Procedure==
# Combine the palm nut extract with water in a pot. The total liquid volume should be roughly double the volume of the rice.
# [[Cookbook:Puréeing|Blend]] the onion and habanero to a chunky paste. Mix into the pot, cover, and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add the ground crayfish, banga spice, stock cube, and salt. Let boil on medium heat.
# Stir in the rice, and cook over medium heat until soft. Add additional water if necessary.
# When the rice has softened, mix in the smoked fish and scent leaf. Give a quick stir, and allow any residual water to absorb/evaporate.
# Remove from heat and serve.
